price_reference.note: Market capitalization is calculated from the retained valuation share denominator rather than copied from a market-data vendor.

cash_overlay.note: No formal net-cash claim is made because a full debt/lease/claims reconciliation was not constructed. This is a conservative valuation overlay using reviewed liquidity less a retained operating reserve.

ttm_diagnostics.note: These are diagnostics only, not normalized FCF multiples. Full economic reinvestment and working-capital normalization are incomplete.

model_method: Ten-year owner-cash scenario DCF. Owner cash is an estimate of normalized cash economics rather than mechanical reported FCF. Each scenario uses explicit revenue growth, owner-margin path, terminal multiple, 9% required return, 49.3M shares and the excess-cash overlay. Scenarios are estimates, not forecasts or price targets.

bear.narrative: AI design share normalizes, 800V conversion is slower, capacity utilization falls, working-capital needs remain high and mature owner-cash margin settles near 12%.

base.narrative: MPS sustains strong AI/data-center design wins, broadens 800V and full-solution content, keeps automotive and communications healthy, and converts capacity expansion into high but gradually normalizing owner-cash margins.

bull.narrative: MPS becomes a major grid-to-core AI power platform, converts 800V sampling into broad production wins, keeps high incremental returns and sustains unusually strong growth and owner-cash margins.

reverse_expectations.method: Hold Base year-1 revenue at $4.4B, owner-margin path from 14% to 20%, 25x terminal multiple, 9% required return, 49.3M shares and $0.914B excess-cash overlay; solve one uniform revenue-growth rate for years 2-10 that matches the September 10 price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: About 19.35% annual revenue growth for nine years after a $4.4B year-1 base is extremely demanding. Current AI/data-center growth prevents calling it demonstrably impossible, but it leaves little room for design-share, margin or capacity-return normalization.

two_state_price_position.note: Algebraic price location only; not an estimated probability.

valuation_conclusion: At $1,186.08, MPWR trades roughly 74% above the modeled Base value and near 72% of the way from Bear to Bull on a simple two-endpoint price-location diagnostic. The business can compound strongly, but the current price requires a long duration of high growth and strong mature owner-cash economics. Expectation gap is insufficient for buy authorization while accounting-control, incremental-ROIC, valuation-duration and permanent-loss gates remain open.
